resources.string: If you already used this authenticator code to sign in, wait for the next code or use an unused recovery code.
Your account password is required with every sign-in method.
To change an existing sign-in method, open Sign-in protection in the Windows Admin Console.
Use your existing authenticator. Its secret is not shown again.
This sign-in method is not supported. Update UNYRI or use the Windows Admin Console.
